records.prompt: Repair a production sprite atlas based on FIRST image, the blonde red cape swordsman. Output transparent alpha PNG, square high resolution. Keep EXACT 8 columns and 10 rows and ALL poses and direction ordering, clothing, proportions, hair, colors and weapons unchanged. There must be 80 complete isolated fullbody figures. IMPORTANT: REDUCE EACH FIGURE AND ITS WEAPON to 65% of its current size ABOUT ITS OWN CELL CENTER. Keep cell center locations, not overall canvas scaling. This creates broad transparent blank gutters all around EVERY figure. Full swords/rifles/hair/capes must NEVER touch neighboring figures or the image edge. Remove every muzzle flash, beam, magic glow and floating particle; clean weapon silhouettes only. Do NOT remove any character. Preserve row counts. No background, no floor shadows, no text, no grid lines. All transparent space. Leave at least 25% cell-width gap between adjacent silhouettes. This is precision cleanup for slicing into sprites. Small pixel sprites with clear shapes.

Production game sprite atlas, NOT concept poster. TRANSPARENT alpha background. 2048x2048 SQUARE canvas. EXACT regular 8 columns by 10 rows, exactly 80 full-body sprites. Every cell exactly 1/8 canvas width by 1/10 canvas height, every sprite fits INSIDE its own cell with at least 35px blank safety gutter on all sides; character body only 60% of cell height, all feet aligned at 80% of cell height. OUTER MARGIN mandatory, nothing may touch canvas edges. Same scale, consistent detailed 3-head-tall pixel art as reference gallery, no text, no borders, no labels, no floor shadows, no cropped weapons, no white background. Character ONLY the specified hero in every cell.
Layout is highly important: Each row contains TWO poses, each shown in FOUR directions. Columns1-4 show pose A in FRONT (faces viewer), BACK (faces away), RIGHT profile, LEFT profile. Columns5-8 show pose B in FRONT, BACK, RIGHT, LEFT. Repeat exactly this direction order EVERY row. 20 poses total, sequential in row order.
Row1 = walk passing left-foot / walk raised left-foot; row2 = walk passing right-foot / walk raised right-foot. Body upright, alternating legs.
Rows3-10 = 16 newly drawn connected combat poses, not repetitions: row3 relaxed ready / low brace; row4 body coils back / stronger weapon windup; row5 peak charge with raised weapon / transition step; row6 acceleration with torso twist / weapon just before contact; row7 full extended strike / compressed recoil; row8 extended follow-through / weight settles; row9 second power preparation with raised free hand / forceful ultimate release; row10 second follow-through / reset to ready.
Each pose has distinctive arms legs and silhouette while matching outfit, hair, size and weapon. No huge VFX baked in; weapon edge can glow only on impact. No motion blur, no other characters, no UI. Draw all 80 complete figures, even the back and side views. Consistent anatomy and weapons, feet fully visible.
MINT, gallery second: long blonde hair, white lilac gold cleric robe and hat, blue gem staff. Melee poses gentle staff strike; charge/release raised staff blessing, cloth follows. No sword.
